## Pull Request

Add / remove / change `{entry name}` in `entries/*.qmd`.

**Short pitch**

Explain why this change improves the directory.

### Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I checked the change against [EDITORIAL_POLICY.md](../EDITORIAL_POLICY.md).
- [ ] I ran `npm install`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] I updated provenance fields where relevant.
- [ ] If I changed source URLs or added entries, I ran `npm run screenshots`.

### Local validation

```bash
npm install
npm run check
```
